# BricksVault

> A premium LEGO portfolio tracker (PWA). Blended market pricing, ROI tracking, camera scanning, and value forecasts for LEGO set and minifigure collections.

BricksVault is a single-page web app. Page content is rendered client-side after
load, and most user data (your vault, wishlist, portfolio value) requires
sign-in — a fetch-only crawler will see the app shell, not personal data.

Set and minifigure valuations are a blend of independent sources: BrickLink
(collector market), PriceCharting (eBay-derived sold comps), eBay sold and active
listings, StockX (sealed lowest ask), and modeled market-guide values with forecasts.

## Key areas
- Vault: your owned sets, blended market value, and ROI vs. purchase price
- Catalog: browse/search ~27,000 LEGO sets with values, deal signals, and coming-soon releases
- Minifigs: minifigure valuations and ownership
- Scan: identify a set by barcode or photo (AI)

## For agents
- This is a JavaScript PWA; there is no server-side-rendered content to scrape.
- Navigation uses in-app hash routes (e.g. #/catalog/10300-1), not distinct crawlable URLs.
- Read-only public config: https://brickvault-api.zhydenko.workers.dev/api/config
- Do not attempt to access authenticated endpoints or private user data.
